title: App crashes when importing a CSV with a BOM

text.body: Importing a UTF-8 CSV that starts with a byte order mark crashes the importer with TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading "trim"). Files without the BOM import fine.

title: CSV import with byte order mark throws TypeError

text.body: If the CSV file has a BOM at the start, import fails with TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined. Saving the CSV without BOM works around it.

title: ENOSPC when watching a large folder

text.body: Opening a folder with 200k files makes the watcher fail with ENOSPC: System limit for number of file watchers reached. Live reload stops after that.

title: File watcher stops with ENOSPC on big projects

text.body: On Ubuntu the file watcher dies with ENOSPC (file watchers limit reached) when the project folder is large, and changes are no longer picked up.

title: Tray icon disappears after sleep on Windows 11

text.body: After the laptop wakes from sleep the tray icon is gone. Restarting the app brings it back.

title: Several small problems after a week of daily use

text.body: I have been using the app every day for a week and collected a few notes. The onboarding tour was clear and the import from my old tool worked well. The settings page could group the sync options better, and the font picker is slow to open. I would like a way to pin notes to the top of a folder. On Windows 11 the tray icon disappears after the laptop wakes from sleep, and I have to restart the app to get the tray icon back. The search panel remembers my last query, which is nice. Exporting to HTML keeps the images, which is great. Thanks for the work on this.

title: Dark theme resets to light after restart

text.body: I choose the dark theme in settings, close the app, and on the next start the theme is light again. The theme preference is not saved.

title: Theme preference not saved between restarts

text.body: Dark mode goes back to the light theme on every restart. The theme preference seems to be lost when the app closes.

title: HTTPS_PROXY is ignored by the sync client

text.body: With HTTPS_PROXY set in the environment the sync client still connects directly and the corporate firewall blocks it.

title: Sync client bypasses proxy from HTTPS_PROXY

text.body: Our network requires a proxy. The HTTPS_PROXY environment variable is ignored and the sync client tries a direct connection, which times out.

title: Plugin install fails with ERR_OSSL_EVP_UNSUPPORTED

text.body: Installing any plugin on Node 17 fails with ERR_OSSL_EVP_UNSUPPORTED from the bundled hashing code.

title: ERR_OSSL_EVP_UNSUPPORTED when installing plugins on Node 18

text.body: Plugin installation stops with error ERR_OSSL_EVP_UNSUPPORTED. Setting the legacy OpenSSL provider makes plugin install work.

title: Search returns no results for words with accents

text.body: Searching for café or über returns zero results, although many notes contain them. Searching cafe finds nothing either.

title: Accented characters break search

text.body: Search finds no results when the query has accents (é, ü). For example café gives zero results even though notes contain café.

title: Exported PNG is blank for a large canvas

text.body: Exporting a canvas larger than 8000 px to PNG produces a blank image. Smaller canvases export correctly.

title: Large canvas export gives an empty PNG

text.body: A canvas of 8192 x 8192 exports as an empty, blank PNG file. At 4096 the PNG export is fine.

title: SIGSEGV on startup under Wayland

text.body: Under a Wayland session the app crashes immediately with SIGSEGV in libwayland-client. Under X11 it runs.

title: Crashes immediately on Wayland with SIGSEGV

text.body: Starting the app on Fedora with Wayland ends in SIGSEGV straight away. Forcing X11 avoids the crash.

title: Ctrl+S does not save in split view

text.body: When the editor is split in two panes, Ctrl+S does nothing and the file stays unsaved. The File menu Save works.

title: Save shortcut ignored in split view

text.body: In split view the save shortcut (Ctrl+S) is ignored, I have to use the File menu to save.

title: Shared folder sync fails with HTTP 409

text.body: Sync of a shared folder fails with HTTP 409 conflict every few minutes. Private folders sync fine.

title: HTTP 409 conflict when syncing shared folders

text.body: Every few minutes sync stops on shared folders with HTTP 409 (conflict). Folders that are not shared are fine.

title: Memory grows to 4 GB overnight

text.body: Leaving the app open overnight, memory use grows to about 4 GB and the machine starts swapping.

title: Memory leak when the app runs overnight

text.body: After a night running, the app uses 4 GB of memory. It looks like a memory leak, memory keeps growing.

title: Docker image fails on arm64: exec format error

text.body: The published Docker image does not start on arm64 hosts: exec format error at container start.

title: exec format error when running the image on Apple Silicon

text.body: On an M2 Mac the container exits at once with exec format error. Looks like the image is amd64 only.

title: arm64 container exits with exec format error

text.body: Raspberry Pi 5 (arm64): docker run of the image prints exec format error and exits.

title: Timeout when uploading attachments to the cloud API

text.body: Uploading an attachment larger than 50 MB to the cloud API ends in a timeout after 30 seconds.

title: Timeout in the local test runner

text.body: The local test runner hits its 5 second timeout on the slow integration tests. This is about the test runner config, not uploads.

title: ENOENT when opening a recent file that was moved

text.body: Clicking a recent file that I moved in the file manager shows ENOENT: no such file or directory instead of removing it from the list.

title: Build fails with ENOENT for the generated schema

text.body: npm run build stops with ENOENT: no such file or directory, open dist/schema.json because the generate step did not run first.

title: Crash when printing a PDF on macOS

text.body: Printing any PDF on macOS crashes the app with NSInternalInconsistencyException in the print panel.

title: Print preview shows wrong margins on macOS

text.body: The print preview on macOS shows margins that are twice as wide as the printed page. Printing itself works.

title: Login fails with 401 after a password change

text.body: After changing my password, login keeps failing with 401 Unauthorized until I clear the cache.

title: Login page layout broken on mobile Safari

text.body: On mobile Safari the login page buttons overlap the password field. Layout only, login itself works.

title: Sync is slow on large folders

text.body: Sync of a folder with 30,000 files takes several minutes even when nothing changed.

title: Sync deletes files in large folders

text.body: Sync removed 200 files from a large folder on my second laptop. They are gone from both machines.

title: Add dark mode to the export dialog

text.body: Feature request: the export dialog could follow dark mode like the rest of the app.

title: Export dialog text unreadable in dark mode

text.body: In dark mode the export dialog shows dark grey text on a black background, so the export options cannot be read.

title: Version 3.2.0 breaks the CLI --json flag

text.body: Since 3.2.0 the CLI ignores --json and prints plain text, which breaks our scripts.

title: Typo in the 3.2.0 release notes

text.body: The 3.2.0 release notes say "synchronisaton". Small typo.

title: Ctrl+B conflicts with bold in the editor

text.body: Ctrl+B now toggles the sidebar instead of making text bold in the editor. The shortcut conflict is annoying.

title: Add a Ctrl+B shortcut to toggle the sidebar

text.body: Feature request: a keyboard shortcut such as Ctrl+B to show and hide the sidebar.

title: Error 500 when saving a note with an emoji title

text.body: Saving a note whose title is only an emoji returns HTTP 500 from the server.

title: Error 500 when the server disk is full

text.body: The self-hosted server answers HTTP 500 to every save once its disk is full. The log says no space left.

title: Installer blocked by antivirus on Windows

text.body: Windows Defender quarantines the installer, so the installer never finishes on company laptops.

title: Installer download is too large for slow connections

text.body: The installer is 400 MB. On a slow connection the installer download takes an hour; a smaller web installer would help.

title: Sync conflict lost my data

text.body: After a sync conflict between my laptop and phone I had data loss: the notes edited on the phone are gone.

title: Sync conflict dialog appears, no data loss

text.body: After a sync conflict between my laptop and phone the conflict dialog appears. There was no data loss, both versions were kept.

title: App crashes on startup after the update

text.body: After the update the app crashes on startup every time, before the window appears.

title: Blank window on startup after the update

text.body: After the update the app does not crash on startup, but the window stays blank for a minute.

title: Export corrupted my vault after the upgrade

text.body: Running export after the upgrade caused corruption of the vault: half the notes open as garbage.

title: Export after the upgrade is slow, no corruption

text.body: Running export after the upgrade is very slow. There is no corruption of the vault, all notes open fine.

title: Lost all my notes after restoring a backup

text.body: Restoring last week's backup wiped my vault. I lost all my notes from this week.

title: Restoring a backup asks twice, nothing was lost

text.body: Restoring last week's backup asks for confirmation twice. Nothing was lost and my vault is fine.

title: Spell checker does not know German

text.body: The spell checker marks every German word as wrong. A language setting would help.

title: Allow custom fonts in the editor

text.body: Please let me choose any installed font for the editor.

title: Table of contents for long notes

text.body: A generated table of contents at the top of long notes would be useful.

title: Calendar view for daily notes

text.body: Show daily notes in a month calendar.

title: Drag and drop images from the browser

text.body: Dragging an image from the browser into a note does nothing on Linux.

title: Option to disable telemetry prompt

text.body: The first-run telemetry prompt appears again after every update.

title: Better diff view for note history

text.body: The history view would be easier to read with a side-by-side diff.

title: Line numbers in code blocks

text.body: Code blocks could show line numbers.

title: Mobile app: swipe to archive

text.body: Swiping a note left could archive it on the phone.

title: Import from Evernote ENEX

text.body: An importer for Evernote ENEX exports would help people switch.
